page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ae.large is a compute-optimized virtual server powered by the KVM hypervisor. It runs on an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T34 processor clocked at 3.4 GHz, configured with 1 physical core presenting 2 dedicated vCPUs via simultaneous multithreading. Hardware cache levels include 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX-512 (F, VNNI, BF16), alongside hardware cryptographic acceleration through AES, VAES, and SHA-NI. The server is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory allocation (2.0 GB per vCPU). It does not include an onboard GPU or bundled local storage, relying on network-attached block storage, and offers a baseline network throughput of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong single-threaded performance driven by the modern AMD EPYC core architecture. It achieves a Geekbench single-core score of 1997.0 and a stress-ng single-core score of 3111.68, placing it in the top quartile of tested instances. However, due to its entry-level allocation of 2 vCPUs and 1 physical core, aggregate multi-threaded metrics fall into lower percentiles, as evidenced by a Geekbench multi-core score of 2481.0, a PassMark CPU score of 3870.88, and a stress-ng multi-core score of 3113.59. Memory subsystem throughput remains consistent for broad workloads, posting 47.32 GB/sec for uncached read blocks and 27.49 GB/sec for uncached write blocks, but PassMark database operations benchmarked poorly at 1075.1.

In terms of resource density, the instance offers a low operational footprint, minimizing expenditure for tasks that do not require wide parallelization. The primary engineering tradeoff is the tight 4.0 GB memory envelope and lack of local NVMe storage, making it unsuitable for large in-memory databases or parallelized data pipelines. The configuration is best aligned with single-threaded compute utilities, lightweight front-end web serving, microservices, or small continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) workers.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ae.large is a compute-optimized instance built on the x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T34 processor operating at 3.4 GHz. It delivers 2 dedicated vCPUs derived from 1 physical core and 4.0 GB of system memory, matching a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. Modern vector instructions such as AVX-512 (F, VNNI, BF16) and cryptographic accelerators (AES, SHA-NI) are supported. The instance has no integrated local storage or GPU hardware and offers 3 Gbps of baseline networking. Benchmark evaluations reflect high single-core capability, reaching a Geekbench single-core score of 1997.0, although overall multi-core throughput and database metric scores are constrained by the dual-thread boundary. With a resource profile emphasizing per-thread compute density over memory volume, ecs.c8ae.large is suited for lightweight web serving, microservices, and dedicated CI/CD build agents.
